title: build validate without jitso/jitso.yaml, or outside a git checkout, is an environment error: exit 3, nothing on stdout
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (build validate: a tolerant check of every build of every layer, one line per file, problem lines, one summary line)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-13, build validate). Exit 3 is for what no build file can explain: a project without `jitso/jitso.yaml` has no allowlists (`jitso: jitso/jitso.yaml is missing: this project has no JITSO allowlists (create it with jitso build new <id>)`), and a working folder outside any git checkout has no project (`jitso: <cwd> is not inside a git checkout`). Nothing is printed on stdout, orca is never called.
